headline: Deadlocked integrates matching batches for US and PAL releases
summary: Deadlocked integrated batches of reconstructed game, engine and network functions, plus PAL-specific work. Matched functions compile to exactly the original game's bytes. The final NTSC-U v1.00 snapshot records 4,475 of 18,085 functions and 350,776 of 5,782,424 code bytes matched; the progress commit separately reports 5,138 of 18,113 PAL functions.
highlights: Two batches add 157 and 167 matched functions, with additional near misses preserved for further work (#50, #51).
PAL batches contribute 210 and 50 matched functions (#52, #53).
Assembler handling of floating-point constants is adjusted to reproduce the original assembler, unblocking C for 27 PAL functions (#49).
Follow-up fixes supply a missing PAL header and remove duplicate PAL copies already matched by shared sources (#52, #53).
